overview: Build a small, brick-built “minifig statue” inspired by the reference: a white-robed Jedi with blonde hair holding a blue lightsaber. Keep it chunky and readable at ~10–12 studs tall using stacked plates/bricks, simple SNOT for the saber, and a stable feet/legs core.

subassemblies.name: Display Base (optional)
subassemblies.description: Small black/DBG plate base to stabilize the statue’s feet and pose.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom of image (not shown as a base, but supports the standing figure).

subassemblies.name: Feet + Lower Legs
subassemblies.description: Two blocky feet with short shins; use mostly White with a few Tan/Gold accents to echo the printed leg details. Build each leg as a 2x2-ish column on a wide foot for stability.

subassemblies.name: Hips / Belt Block
subassemblies.description: A 4–6 stud wide waist section that transitions from legs to torso. Add a dark red/brown belt stripe using Red/DarkRed/ReddishBrown plates and a small centered “buckle/pouch” greeble.

subassemblies.name: Torso / Robe Chest
subassemblies.description: Main upper-body block in White. Suggest the robe wrap using a few DarkBluishGray/Black lines (thin plates/tiles) and slight layering to create a V-shape impression. Keep shoulders squared and simple.
subassemblies.image_location: Center (white torso with robe fold lines).

subassemblies.name: Arms + Hands (2 submodules)
subassemblies.description: Two White arms built as narrow columns/hinged stacks attached at the sides of the torso. Hands in LightNougat/MediumNougat tones (or tan-ish substitutes) clasping in front to hold the hilt. Pose: both arms forward and slightly bent.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber (Hilt + Blade)
subassemblies.description: Cylindrical-looking gray hilt using LightBluishGray/DarkBluishGray pieces; attach a TransLightBlue/Blue blade made from trans-clear elements with blue plates behind/within for color. Connect to hands as a single accessory module.
subassemblies.image_location: Right side, angled upward (blue blade with gray hilt).

subassemblies.name: Neck / Head Core
subassemblies.description: A small transition stack to center the head on the torso; keep it mostly White/LBG to hide structure.

subassemblies.name: Head (brick-built)
subassemblies.description: A 3–4 stud wide light “skin-tone” cube/rounded block; add minimal facial suggestion with tiny black elements or tiles (eyes/brows) and a small mouth mark. Keep it iconic, not detailed.

subassemblies.name: Hair / Hood-like Blonde Top
subassemblies.description: Layered “swoop” hair mass in Yellow/Tan/Light tones, stepped plates/curves to suggest the swept bangs and volume. Overhang slightly at the front and sides.

notes: Color match: prioritize White for robes; use Red/DarkRed/ReddishBrown for belt; LBG/DBG for saber hilt; Blue + TransClear/Trans elements for blade glow.
Use wide feet (each at least 4x3 footprint) and connect legs with a solid hip block to prevent wobble.
Keep the silhouette readable: big white robe, blonde hair cap, and a strong diagonal blue saber.
If you have enough trans parts, stack/line them for the blade and back it with MediumAzure/Blue plates to intensify the color.
